Both get a credit equal to 100% of their November platform fees, issued as credit memos on their December invoices, no cash: **Loomly $18,400** and **Pinecrest Rentals $6,200**, total $24,600 [1][4][5][8]. It started as a 50% proposal on Nov 12, but Rachel pushed to 100% for both after talking to Loomly [4]. Loomly was told the $18,400 credit in the support thread [5], Pinecrest's $6,200 was confirmed by email to Grant Holloway [8].

On the November books: yes, accrued — Marcus decided on Nov 17 to book it as a contra-revenue accrual in November (Dr service credits / Cr accrued customer credits $24,600), reversing when the December credit memos are issued; Jenna posts the JE [1]. The close checklist lists the "Service credits accrual – payout incident (Loomly, Pinecrest)" item with Marcus, in progress [7].

Not included: Loomly's separate request to reimburse its sellers' overdraft fees (214 sellers, $7,690) is not accrued — no decision by the close date, flagged as an open item in the close memo, answer promised to Loomly by Nov 25 [1].
